analysis.one_line_summary: A young woman styles and curls her long dark hair in fast motion using a pink hair styling tool to French upbeat background music.
analysis.full_description: A vertical social media video where a young woman in a black t-shirt curls sections of her long dark hair using a pink Wavytalk curling/straightening tool. The footage is sped up in a GRWM style with the on-screen caption 'curl my hair with me in 2x speed ✨💕💆‍♀️'. Upbeat French pop/rap music plays in the background with no spoken dialogue. She demonstrates curling both sides of her hair and finishes by posing and smiling to display her voluminous, bouncy waves.

on_screen_text.text: curl my hair with me in 2x speed ✨💕💆‍♀️

scenes.visual: A young woman seated in an office chair in a room, holding a pink styling tool and wrapping a strand of hair around it.
scenes.action: She clamps and begins twisting the pink styler through a strand on her left side.

scenes.visual: Close-up of her hands rotating and gliding the pink hair styler down the section of hair.
scenes.action: She glides the tool through her hair to form a curl.

scenes.visual: Medium shot of the creator curling another upper section of hair on her left side.
scenes.action: She releases a defined bouncy wave and shakes it out gently.

scenes.visual: Medium shot showing her curling the hair on the right side of her head.
scenes.action: She clamps the hair section, twists the styler, and pulls it downward in fast forward.

scenes.visual: Creator puts down the styler and runs her fingers through her hair, showing off the full wavy hairstyle.
scenes.action: She frames her face with both hands, flips her curls, and smiles playfully at the camera.
